title: pcapng: move the Netflix custom block and option code.
description:
Put it in its own file, and remove it from pcapng.c.

The ultimate goal is to 1) make it unnecessary to modify any of the core
pcapng code to support custom blocks and options and 2) make it possible
to support them in plugins.
